review_method: Source-backed offline assistant review against unchanged case rubrics, corpus, synthetic fixtures and saved agent/MCP traces. No live judge or provider request. Independent human audit recommended.
definitions: Reuse offline-scores.json definitions. Workflow completion requires substantive rubric obligations and required tools, not merely an expected status. Conditional exception advice is not itself an actual clarification/escalation response.
citation_counting: Count listed policy section references supporting at least one material answer claim, once per Sources list. Repeated inline/Policy references are not extra units. The MCP balance attribution in EVAL-010/011 is verified separately, not counted as a policy section citation.

claims.claim: Temporary out-of-state work must have prior written approval from both manager and People Operations
claims.reason: Conservative scope judgment: the cited handbook requires both for permanent changes; HR-004 requires prior written People Operations approval for temporary interstate work and separately describes manager review, not both written approvals for every temporary arrangement.

claims.claim: HR-004 governs remote location approval and equipment
Interstate work requires written approval because of tax, security, employment and contract considerations
Remote hires follow the same security rules as office employees
Use approved devices/systems, a safe private workspace and reliable internet
IT arranges secure equipment shipment for remote hires
IT-001 and SEC-001 govern device and information controls
Remote location approval is separately governed by HR-004
Location changes may affect leave/accrual/payout rules; notify People Operations before moving

records.notes: One successful policy search returned handbook/onboarding/PTO excerpts, not direct HR-004 or SEC-001 passages. Merely missing expected source IDs is not an automatic correctness failure. Substantive limitations are the permanent-versus-temporary approval conflation and absent concrete security controls such as MFA and approved remote access from HR-004 4.1/SEC-001 2.1-2.4. The requested combined approval/security workflow is therefore incomplete. No individual approval, compliance or device-security determination was claimed.
